rationale.text: The page itself carries no listed attribute; the cross-site document in its frame has a paragraph with align. The test speaks of the generated source of the pages and does not say whether a framed document belongs to it. The custom check answers cannot_tell for a listed attribute in a nested browsing context (step 2); only the record supports this branch. The iframe element itself carries only title and src. The finding is needs_review at both levels: not_enabled at fail_only, cannot_tell at full.

citations.quote: les attributs servant à la présentation de l’information ne doivent pas être présents dans le code source généré des pages
